fields.Name: T306 - Communication Templates New Template
fields.Description: Covers the bespoke card page's addNewTemplate() -> NavigationService.OpenEntityRecord('MJ: Templates', empty key) create-navigation entry point, distinct from opening an existing record.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Templates section. Click the 'New Template' button in the header. Success = a blank Templates record/edit form opens (typically in a new tab), ready to create a template with editable fields such as Name. You do NOT need to fill it in or save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking New Template opens a blank Templates (MJ: Templates) entity form
The form renders editable fields (e.g., Name) for a new template
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
